dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001279\_43](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001279) Category 1 during the period Jul 01 2026-Jul 11 2026 in Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Japan, Taiwan, China. The center of the storm was located near latitude 27.6 longitude 121.8. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
